### Who Will Eat Bread in God’s Kingdom?
Author: Deidre Braley
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/who-will-eat-bread-in-gods-kingdom-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Luke 14:15
Points:
- Earthly wealth and comfort can blind people to their desperate need for God.
- The original invitees allowed routine daily concerns to crowd out communion with the master.
- Those who recognize their spiritual poverty and powerlessness eagerly receive God's banquet invitation.
- The kingdom feast is enjoyed by those who acknowledge their hunger and run to be filled by Christ.

### A Christian’s Job Description: Go and Tell
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-september-8-2017.html
Passage: Luke 14:23-24
Points:
- God has prepared an eternal heavenly banquet and desires a full house.
- Every follower of Jesus shares the calling of the servant sent to gather the guests.
- Believers are charged to invite people to salvation with deliberate speed and urgency.
- People who cling to worldly excuses will miss out entirely on the blessings God has prepared.

### The Wedding Feast
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://www.ligonier.org/learn/devotionals/wedding-feast
Passage: Matthew 22:1-10
Points:
- God graciously summoned His covenant people through the prophets to celebrate the feast for His Son.
- Those with the greatest religious advantages tragically took the invitation lightly and rejected it.
- The king's banquet was subsequently opened to outsiders who gladly received the gracious call.
- Believers must not take divine grace for granted or squander kingdom gifts through indifference.
